brief.summary_1line: Lakshmana and Kausalya plead with Rama to resist exile, but Rama firmly insists on obeying his father's command as the highest duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana, furious and gripping his bow, vows to fight the whole city to place Rama on the throne.
Queen Kausalya collapses in grief before Rama, pleading with him not to abandon her for the forest.
Rama stands calm and composed before his grieving mother and enraged brother, insisting he must obey his father’s command.
